name: UNISOL Holdings Corporation
summary: UNISOL Holdings Corporation engages in the machinery and tools, construction machinery and materials, and IoT businesses in Japan. The company sells industrial machinery, equipment, and tools, such as machine tools, press machines, injection molding machines, robots, logistics machines, and other equipment; and screws, hardware, welding materials, painting materials, and machine tools for steel frame construction companies, as well as turnbuckles, braces, and plumbing materials for plant plumbers.
